body.heading: Where in the world is Lithuania?
paragraphs: Lithuania is a country in Northern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Lithuania is Vilnius.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Lithuania is Lithuanian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Lithuania is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Lithuania?
paragraphs: Lithuania covers about 65,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Greece.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Trakai's red-brick castle stands on an island in Lake Galvė — cross the wooden bridge, tour its halls, then eat kibinai pastries by the water.
Vilnius has one of Europe's largest old towns, of baroque churches and courtyards; further north, the Hill of Crosses holds thousands of crosses left by pilgrims.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Lithuania on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
